label: S1 syntax test of the cell query on five literal rows (FROM values(...), no pypi table)
query: SELECT total, older, at_or_newer, other, older_ci_true, length(tupleElement(m6, 1)) AS cells6,  tupleElement(m6, 1)[indexOf(tupleElement(m6, 2), arrayMax(tupleElement(m6, 2)))] AS top6_key,  arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> toString(x), arraySlice(arrayReverseSort(tupleElement(m6, 2)), 1, 1001)), ' ') AS top6_sizes,  tupleElement(o5, 1)[indexOf(tupleElement(o5, 2), arrayMax(tupleElement(o5, 2)))] AS otop5_key,  arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(x -> toString(x), arraySlice(arrayReverseSort(tupleElement(o5, 2)), 1, 1001)), ' ') AS otop5_sizes FROM (  SELECT sum(n) AS total, sumIf(n, cls = 'older') AS older, sumIf(n, cls = 'at_or_newer') AS at_or_newer, sumIf(n, cls = 'other') AS other,   sumIf(n, cls = 'older' AND ci = 'true') AS older_ci_true,   sumMap([concat(py, '|', inst, '|', sys, '|', lib, '|', ci, '|', cc)], [n]) AS m6,   sumMapIf([concat(py, '|', inst, '|', sys, '|', lib, '|', ci)], [n], cls = 'older') AS o5  FROM (   SELECT multiIf(v IN ('2','3'), 'at_or_newer', v IN ('1'), 'older', 'other') AS cls, py, inst, sys, lib, toString(c) AS ci, cc, count() AS n   FROM values('v String, py String, inst String, sys String, lib String, c Enum8(\'false\' = 0, \'true\' = 1, \'unknown\' = 2), cc String',    ('1','3.9','pip','Linux','glibc','false','US'), ('1','3.9','pip','Linux','glibc','false','US'), ('2','3.12','uv','Linux','','true','DE'), ('9','3.9','pip','Linux','glibc','false','US'), ('1','3.9','pip','Linux','glibc','false','IE'))   GROUP BY cls, py, inst, sys, lib, ci, cc  ) ) FORMAT CSVWithNames
